$comment: Merge into ~/.claude/settings.json (your user settings). Some keys are honored only at user/managed level, not in the repo's .claude/settings.json. The watch-hooks entries run a copy of .claude/hooks/watch-hooks.py installed outside the repository (GUARDRAILS.md, 'The watcher hook'); replace /Users/YOUR_NAME with your home directory (write the absolute path, not ~).

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys,datetime; d=json.load(sys.stdin); open(__import__('os').path.expanduser('~/claude-config-audit.log'),'a').write(json.dumps({'t':datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),'source':d.get('source'),'file':d.get('file_path')})+'\n'); print(json.dumps({'decision':'block','reason':'Settings changed during the session. Review the change and restart the session to apply it.'}))"
